price.source: NYSE close 2026-10-09 (last trading day before as_of, a Sunday); stockanalysis.com/stocks/hubs/history and financialcontent.com/quote/NY:HUBS/historical agree

shares.source: Q2 2026 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526335232/hubs-20260630.htm): basic 49,658K outstanding at 2026-06-30 (balance sheet) + 2,745K RSUs/PSUs excluded as anti-dilutive (Note 3, Q2 weighted avg, counted in full: zero strike) + 46K dilutive equivalents from options/RSUs/ESPP by treasury stock method (Note 3)

debt.source: Q2 2026 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526335232/hubs-20260630.htm): 2025 convertible notes settled June 2025; $500M revolver undrawn at 2026-06-30 (fact pack A4)

cash.source: Q2 2026 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526335232/hubs-20260630.htm): cash 958,314K + ST inv. 379,629K + LT inv. 45,265K at 2026-06-30 (fact pack A4)

other_ev_adjustments.name: Restructuring cash cost announced 2026-10-06 (midpoint of $65-75M; not in TTM FCF)

base_revenue.source: Derived: FY2025 3,131,266K (10-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526046646/hubs-20251231.htm) + H1 2026 1,792,735K - H1 2025 1,475,003K (10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526335232/hubs-20260630.htm); ties to fact pack A1

base_fcf_margin.definition: (OCF 856,365K - PP&E 58,869K - capitalized software 139,059K - SBC 514,712K) / revenue, TTM to 2026-06-30 = 143,725K / 3,448,998K
base_fcf_margin.source: Derived from GAAP cash-flow lines, FY2025 10-K + Q2 2026 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1404655/000119312526335232/hubs-20260630.htm); ties to fact pack A3

discount_rate.method: CAPM cost of equity (no debt, so WACC = cost of equity): 5.24% + 1.25 x 4.20% = 10.49%, rounded to 10.5%

risk_free.source: US Treasury daily par yield curve, 10-year, 2026-10-09 (home.treasury.gov); FRED DGS10 5.22% on 2026-10-08 agrees

beta.source: Damodaran, Software (System & Application), unlevered beta corrected for cash, Jan 2026 update (309 firms); relevered at HubSpot D/E = 0. Cross-check: HUBS 5-year regression beta 1.24 (stockanalysis.com, 2026-10-10)

equity_risk_premium.source: Damodaran implied ERP for the S&P 500 on 2026-10-01 (trailing 12-month cash yield, adjusted payout), pages.stern.nyu.edu/~adamodar/New_Home_Page/home.htm

terminal_growth.source: Judgment: below the nominal-GDP cap because a mature software franchise should grow with, not faster than, the economy; sensitivity at 2.5%, 3.5% and the 4.0% cap in memo
terminal_growth.cap_source: FOMC Summary of Economic Projections, 2026-09-16: longer-run median real GDP growth 2.0% + PCE inflation 2.0% = ~4.0% nominal (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcprojtabl20260916.htm)

Intuit.source: FY2026 10-K (FYE 2026-07-31): (OCF 8,838M - PP&E 175M - capitalized software 46M - SBC 2,056M) / revenue 21,448M; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/896878/000089687826000037/intu-20260731.htm
